components-banner.name: Banner
components-banner.description:
Message banner. Always shows an icon and words together, so the status never depends on colour alone.
 Errors are announced to screen readers immediately; the others politely.

reactDocgen.description:
Message banner. Always shows an icon and words together, so the status never depends on colour alone.

title.description: Short heading. Optional, but recommended when the message has more than one sentence.

children.description: The message itself: say what happened and what to do next.

onDismiss.description: If given, a close button appears. The page decides what happens on close.

components-chip.name: Chip
components-chip.description:
Small pill of text for a fact, a count or a short label. It is not clickable.
 The dashed tone is for provisional or estimated information, and the words must say so:
 the dashed line alone never carries the meaning.

reactDocgen.description:
Small pill of text for a fact, a count or a short label. It is not clickable.

 the dashed line alone never carries the meaning.

tone.description: outline = a fact or a count. solid = a label that stands out. dashed = provisional or estimated.

icon.description: Optional icon shown before the words.

children.description: Short words. Wrap a number in to show it larger, for example: 10 questions.
